elements.text:
You've agreed with your friends to play a game online together. When you log in you can see that no one is online. Why isn't anyone online yet? 
 
They've most probably secretly agreed to play a different online game because they don't want to game with me.  

On a scale of 1-5, how likely is this thought to pop into your mind?

buttons: 1::1: Doesn't pop up in my mind;2::2;3::3: Might pop up in my mind;4::4;5::5: Definitely pops up in my mind;
